spotlight.aura.label: Flagship
spotlight.aura.title:
Aura.
Light and air, perfected.
spotlight.aura.desc: The definitive merenro fan light. A 52-inch span, CRI 97+ ring lighting, and a brushless motor so quiet you forget it is running.
spotlight.breeze.label: Bedroom
spotlight.breeze.title:
Breeze.
Sleep in silence.
spotlight.breeze.desc: Four aerodynamic blades and a dedicated sleep mode drop noise to 22 dB. A warm amber night light guides you without disrupting rest.
spotlight.harbor.label: Living Room
spotlight.harbor.title:
Harbor.
Built for open spaces.
spotlight.harbor.desc: A 56-inch sweep moves 10,200 m³/h of air across large rooms. Five blades and dual LED rings deliver even coverage from wall to wall.
feature.silent.label: Quiet Motor
feature.silent.title:
As low as 28 dB.
Quieter than a whisper.
feature.silent.desc: An aerospace-grade brushless DC motor with precision dynamic balancing keeps operation nearly silent—even at maximum speed. Let the breeze fade into the background.
feature.light.label: Full-Spectrum Lighting
feature.light.title:
2700K to 6500K.
From warm dusk to clear daylight.
feature.light.desc: 120 high-CRI LEDs (CRI 97+) with stepless color temperature and brightness adjusted down to 1%. Whether reading, dining, or relaxing, find the light that feels right.
feature.smart.label: Smart Connectivity
feature.smart.title:
One command.
Air and light, together.
feature.smart.desc: Works with HomeKit, Mi Home, and Tmall Genie—or control remotely via the merenro app. Set scenes, schedules, and even auto-adjust fan speed based on room temperature.
design.label: Design
design.title:
Minimal.
Refined in every detail.
design.material.title: Aerospace Aluminum
design.material.desc: CNC-machined from a single block with anodized finish—smooth to the touch and built to last.
design.blade.title: Aerodynamic Blades
design.blade.desc: Bio-inspired airfoil design in a three-blade layout for smoother airflow and 40% wider coverage.
design.ring.title: Ring Diffused Light
design.ring.desc: Hidden LED strip with diffused reflection eliminates glare and evenly lights the entire room.
